title: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 tablespoon of oil in a heavy-bottomed kadhai or pan over medium flame.
Add cumin seeds and allow them to crackle, then add finely chopped onions and sauté until soft and golden brown.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes until the raw fragrance vanishes completely.
Pour in the tomato puree, turmeric, Kashmiri red chilli powder, and salt, stirring thoroughly to blend spices.
Cook the masala base on medium-low flame for 8 to 10 minutes until the oil begins separating from the pan edges.
Gently fold in the paneer cubes along with 1/2 cup of warm water, cover with a lid, and simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.
Finish by stirring in fresh heavy cream, crushed kasuri methi, and garam masala before garnishing with chopped coriander.

title: Dal Makhani
ingredients: 1 cup Whole Black Gram (Sabut Urad Dal), soaked overnight
instructions: Pressure cook the soaked urad dal and rajma with 4 cups of water and salt for 6 to 8 whistles until ultra-soft and mashable.
Heat ghee and 1 tablespoon of butter in a deep heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute, then add tomato puree and Kashmiri red chilli powder.
Cook the tomato paste until oil releases from the sides of the pot, stirring continuously.
Pour in the pressure-cooked dal mixture and gently mash a portion of the lentils with the back of a ladle for thickness.
Simmer the dal on low heat for 40 to 45 minutes, adding small splashes of hot water whenever needed.
Stir in the remaining butter, fresh cream, and garam masala, letting it simmer for another 5 minutes until velvety smooth.
